name: Siegfried Mureşan - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: Draft amending budget 2/2024: surplus of the financial year 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament approves the Council's position on amending the 2024 European Union budget to enter the 2023 surplus of 633 million euro. This reduces the total amount member states must pay into the 2024 budget. Parliament welcomes the lower surplus compared with 2022, which shows better budget forecasting. It also repeats its view that fines should count as extra income for the European Union budget rather than lowering member states' contributions, and it calls on the Council to move faster on reforming the European Union's own revenue sources.

- The 2023 surplus of 633 million euro is added to the 2024 budget, lowering member states' payments.
- Member states pay less into the 2024 budget; five countries keep their budget rebates, worth about 5.4 billion euro net.
- Parliament approves the budget change; its president will declare it finally adopted and publish it.
